watching.org: Alfred Toepfer Stiftung F.V.S., with Arena for Journalism in Europe
watching.summary: Two-part training and networking programme in which European journalists develop cross-border investigation ideas together, ending with a follow-up meeting at the Dataharvest conference.
watching.status: Closed, 2026 round has ended; the page says the next call will be announced in late autumn/early winter.

watching.title: Daniel Pearl Investigative Journalism Initiative (DPIJI) Fellowship
watching.summary: One fellow a year gets financial and editorial support to report a long-form investigation on anti-Semitism or other entrenched prejudice, published in Moment.
watching.status: Closed for 2026 (deadline was 20 August 2026); next round not stated.

watching.title: McGraw Fellowship for Business Journalism
watching.org: Harold W. McGraw, Jr. Center for Business Journalism, CUNY Craig Newmark Graduate School of Journalism
watching.summary: Grants and editing support for experienced journalists to produce in-depth investigative or enterprise stories with a business, financial or economic angle.
watching.status: Closed, fall 2026 deadline was 12 October 2026; the page lists the next (Spring 2027) deadline as October 12, 2027, exactly as written.

watching.title: UC Berkeley Journalism Fellowships
watching.org: UC Berkeley Graduate School of Journalism
watching.summary: Hub for Berkeley fellowships: reporting grants on psychedelics, a psychedelic documentary fellowship, and paid California local-news placements for early-career reporters.
watching.status: Closed: Mycoskie documentary deadline (extended to 13 October) has passed, Ferriss applications closed, 2026 California Local News Fellowship application closed.

watching.title: Knight Science Journalism Fellowships at MIT
watching.summary: Residential MIT fellowships where science journalists pursue a journalism project and audit courses; one semester-long track is for journalists from Africa and the Middle East.
watching.status: Closed for now: next round opens 15 November 2026 and closes 9 January 2027.

watching.title: Collaborative and Investigative Journalism Initiative (CIJI)
watching.org: CIJI: Free Press Unlimited, Tactical Tech, RSF, Fundacja Reporterów, OBC Transeuropa and Delfi, with EU support
watching.summary: EU-funded initiative offering recurring grants, residencies and training for collaborative and investigative journalism, announced as separate calls on its announcements page.
watching.status: No open call listed; recent grant and residency calls have closed, and the page suggests subscribing to the newsletter for future ones.
